data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 15.2m (2018 favourable development: GBP 42.8m). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 618.131m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse movement on prior underwriting years of c. GBP 38.4m (strengthening, ~6.2% of opening gross reserves) driven by movements in older underwriting years (notably 2013-2017 columns in the gross triangle). The report also highlights a net favourable prior year development on a net-of-reinsurance basis of GBP 15.2m, reflecting the combined effect of favourable run-off in some classes and reinsurance recoveries; current-year adverse weather-related crop losses and adverse activity in certain accounts (Personal Accident, Financial Institutions) are noted elsewhere in the report and partially offset by benign experience on M&A, Property Binders and Political Risks.
raw_causal_phrases: severe weather-related crop losses (from Q4 2019) across China, the United States of America and India which significantly impacted our Agriculture treaty book of business.

The Personal Accident and Financial Institutions accounts also suffered adverse claims activity in the year, partially offset by a benign claims experience on M&A, Property Binders and Political Risks.
Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 15.2m (2018 favourable development: GBP 42.8m).
The Syndicate reports a loss for the year of GBP 3.0m, reflecting higher than expected claims activity predominantly in the second half of the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims by underwriting year) because the report does not present a single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure. The triangle-derived gross PYD (+GBP 38.404m adverse) conflicts with the report's net-of-reinsurance narrative that cites a favourable prior year development of GBP 15.2m. Lob movements shown above are taken from the 'Claims incurred, net of reinsurance' prior year breakdown (note 4) and are therefore net-of-reinsurance figures; their mapping to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate. Confidence flags indicate where calculations (triangle) or net/inferred figures were used.
